title: A Modular Agent for Reliable and Auditable Spatial Relation Verification in CT Scans
abstract: arXiv:2608.21140v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable spatial understanding is an important prerequisite for future medical vision-language systems that aim to support radiological report generation and structured image understanding. While modern vision-language models (VLMs) show promising performance on many medical imaging tasks, recent evidence suggests they remain weak in controlled spatial reasoning and often fail to reliably ground spatial relations in image evidence. Given that radiological reasoning hinges on understanding the relative positions of anatomical structures and findings, this spatial weakness poses risks to diagnostic accuracy. We present a modular medical imaging agent for binary spatial relation verification in axial CT slices. Instead of directly predicting spatial answers end-to-end, the system decomposes the task into explicit stages: language parsing, anatomical localization, and deterministic geometric verification. translated_title: 一种用于CT扫描中可靠且可审计的空间关系验证的模块化智能体
translated_abstract: 可靠的空間理解是未来医学视觉语言系统的重要前提，这些系统旨在支持放射学报告生成和结构化图像理解。尽管现代视觉语言模型（VLMs）在许多医学影像任务中表现出有前景的性能，但近期证据表明，它们在受控空间推理方面仍然薄弱，并且常常无法可靠地将空间关系基于图像证据进行落地。鉴于放射学推理依赖于理解解剖结构和发现的相对位置，这种空间弱点对诊断准确性构成风险。我们提出了一种用于轴向CT切片中二元空间关系验证的模块化医学影像智能体。该系统不直接端到端地预测空间答案，而是将任务分解为明确的阶段：语言解析、解剖定位和确定性几何验证。自然语言查询被转换...
tldr: 本文提出一种模块化医学影像智能体，通过分解语言解析、解剖定位和几何验证步骤，提升CT扫描中空间关系验证的可靠性和可审计性，弥补视觉语言模型在空间推理上的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a modular medical imaging agent that decomposes spatial relation verification in CT scans into language parsing, anatomical localization, and geometric verification stages, enhancing reliability and auditability over end-to-end vision-language models.
